feat(camellia): migrate OTA and device console pages (#43)

## Summary
- add a shared camellia workspace framework for DAM-27 that covers OTA, device, IoT card, and material purchase pages
- wire visible menu routes plus hidden item/manage/setting routes for OTA manage, model classification, device, blacklist, firmware, firmware logs, firmware part numbers, IoT card, IoT package, and material purchase
- extend seeded permission nodes so hidden child pages are still access-controlled and reachable through the unified shell

## Validation
- `cd bougainvillea && pnpm run check:camellia`
- `PORT=3210 pnpm --filter @bougainvillea/camellia start`
- `curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3210/universal/ota/manage`
- `curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3210/universal/ota/device-blacklist`
- `curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3210/universal/iot_card/card/item/iot-card-cn11`
- `curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3210/universal/material-purchase/setting`

## Notes
- this is a baseline migration: the pages use shared scaffolds and seeded records so complex list/detail/manage/setting flows can land on one consistent shell before backend-specific wiring expands
